name: defender-off-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): neuters Microsoft Defender -- sets the DisableAntiSpyware policy to 1, turns OFF real-time monitoring via Set-MpPreference, and optionally registers a folder exclusion. The hardened state is real-time protection back on, the policy cleared, and no attacker-folder exclusions left behind. Vars: EXCLUSION_PATH (optional -- registered as a Defender scan exclusion). Pairs with powershell_json checks over Get-MpComputerStatus (RealTimeProtection) and Get-MpPreference exclusions, plus a registry_value check on DisableAntiSpyware. Idempotent.
